RobertNPC.name: Robert
RobertNPC.title: taxi driver
RobertNPC.desc: A young man who hangs around near the orphanage. He always looks short on sleep, but his eyes are sharp.
_comment_flat_keys: Flat keys below: the key IS the English source text. ModI18N routes every NPC name display through setup.NPC_CN_NAME(...) and its own name list has no Robert; maplebirch patches that function to fall back to this language store, so an entry keyed by the English text is what makes the name localized. See ensureI18nNameFix in framework.js.
a young man who works near the orphanage: a young man who works near the orphanage
RobertNPC.intro.title: A Stranger on the Corner
RobertNPC.intro.text: You spot a young man leaning against a wall on the corner, smoking. He notices your look and stubs the cigarette out.
RobertNPC.intro.greet: "...You're new here?" He puts his hands in his pockets. "Name's Robert."
RobertNPC.intro.leave: You decide not to get involved and walk away.
RobertNPC.menu.title: Robert
RobertNPC.talk.idle: Robert answers absently. There isn't much to talk about between you yet.
RobertNPC.widget.title: Robert
RobertNPC.taxi.chanceHint: The chance that a taxi driver is Robert rather than a stranger. The remaining chance all goes to the stranger, so the two always add up to 100%. Adjustable range: 0-90%.
RobertNPC.taxi.fare: You get into the taxi. The fare is £5.
RobertNPC.taxi.driver.stranger: The driver is a quiet stranger. He says nothing the whole way, and drives steadily.
RobertNPC.taxi.robertGreetFirst: The driver glances at you in the rear-view mirror. "...It's you." He drops the meter. "Name's Robert. Just wave if you need a ride."
RobertNPC.taxi.robertGreet: It's Robert's taxi again. He nods at you in the rear-view mirror.
RobertNPC.taxi.chooseSeat: You get in. Robert asks where you'd like to sit.
RobertNPC.taxi.frontSeat: You take the passenger seat and look out of the window as the car pulls away.
RobertNPC.taxi.handMove: Robert keeps both hands on the wheel. After a while his right hand leaves it, drifts slowly towards you, and comes to rest on your leg.
RobertNPC.taxi.handAid: Robert's rough touch snaps your senses to full alert. Your gaze drops from the window to your leg, where his hand now rests.
RobertNPC.taxi.slowDown: Robert gradually slows the car. His right hand strokes your leg gently.
RobertNPC.taxi.caress: Robert's right hand keeps stroking your leg, sometimes firmly, sometimes slowly.
RobertNPC.taxi.arrive: Robert lifts his hand from your leg and returns it to the wheel. The taxi accelerates, and soon you arrive at your destination.
RobertNPC.taxi.ruleDefault: Robert only appears on Tuesdays and Fridays, with a 10% chance on those days; 90% for a stranger.
RobertNPC.taxi.ruleAlways: Robert always appears (100%); 0% for a stranger.
RobertNPC.opinion.low.lustLow.domLow: hopes you'll ride with them often.
RobertNPC.opinion.low.lustLow.domMin: has no strong opinion of you.
RobertNPC.opinion.mid.domHigh: thinks you can relieve their stress.
